[by Claude Code] ## Motivation The cookbook's **Agentic Long-Context Deployment** sections (#42726, #43083 and later syncs) mirror SemiAnalysis InferenceX AgentX submissions as raw launch commands, each linked to the run that measured it. The configurations are mirrored from SemiAnalysis submissions. The Qwen3.8-Flash-Next H200 lane still shows the day-zero submission: [InferenceX #2753](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2753), measured in [run 33038487711](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/33038487711) on the `lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38flashnext` image. [InferenceX #4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272) moves that lane to the `v0.5.22` release and adds TP2 points. This PR mirrors the new lane. ## Source [InferenceX](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX) `main` (`9a132463`), with this open InferenceX PR overlaid: | PR | Page | Lane | Pinned to | |---|---|---|---| | [#4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272) Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 H200 SGLang | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | `qwen3.8next-fp8-h200-sglang-agentic-mtp` | [run 39109720946](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39109720946), named by the PR's [`/use` comment](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272#issuecomment-6252968837) (head `0d749be1`), verified | Only the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next page is regenerated. Its source line now lists [InferenceX #4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272) only. The other pages still name [InferenceX #4033](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4033) (merged since) and [InferenceX #4162](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4162) (Qwen3.5); neither has a Qwen3.8-Flash-Next lane. ## What this PR does | Page | Lanes | Deployments | Points | Hardware | |---|---|---|---|---| | Qwen3.8-Flash-Next | 4 | 5 (was 4) | 24 (was 22) | GB300, B300, B200, H200 | - **Qwen3.8-Flash-Next FP8 H200 SGLang ([InferenceX #4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272)).** | | Before ([InferenceX #2753](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/2753)) | After ([InferenceX #4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272)) | |---|---|---| | Image | `lmsysorg/sglang:qwen38flashnext` | `lmsysorg/sglang:v0.5.22-cu130`, pinned by digest (`sha256:e3a4f060…`) | | Deployments | Agg TP4·EP4: c1, 4, 8, 12, 16 | Agg TP2·EP2: c1, 8, 12, 14, 16
Agg TP4·EP4: c1, 8 | | Admission and decode graphs | `--max-running-requests` = 2× concurrency
`--cuda-graph-max-bs` = concurrency | `--max-running-requests` = `--cuda-graph-max-bs-decode` = 2× concurrency | | ReplaySSM | — | `--enable-linear-replayssm-spec` on TP2·EP2 c8, c12, c14, c16 | | Environment | `SGLANG_ENABLE_SPEC_V2=1` | none: the image's SGLang (`baa9befa`) no longer reads this variable | | `--tokenizer-path` | the model id | not set (defaults to the model) | - **Unchanged:** - checkpoint `Qwen/Qwen3.8-Flash-Next-FP8` with its in-checkpoint NEXTN head (MTP 3-1-4); - `--mamba-ssm-dtype float32`; - FlashInfer linear-attention prefill and decode backends; - `--chunked-prefill-size 8192` and `--mem-fraction-static 0.85`; - `--stream-interval 50`, `--scheduler-recv-interval 10` and `--tokenizer-worker-num 6`; - SGLang router and no KV offload, as measured; - the synthetic-acceptance disclosure (golden AL 2.32). - **Derived variants (not run):** - Dynamo + SGLang, as on every lane. - The Mooncake store tier is new for H200: the old image predated `--enable-unified-cache-external-linker`, and `v0.5.22` has it. - HiCache stays unavailable for this lane. - **GB300, B300 and B200:** unchanged. Their deployments are byte-identical to `main`. ## How the commands are produced The pipeline and rules are the same as in #44712, with these changes. None of them alters an existing deployment: GB300, B300 and B200 come out byte-identical to `main`. - **Composed recipes.** [InferenceX #4272](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/pull/4272) is the first Qwen3.8-Flash-Next lane in InferenceX's composed-recipe layout. - The recipe is a fragment: InferenceX binds the master config's model, image, precision and point values at launch, then picks one `override_tp{N}_c{M}` variant per point. - The pipeline now does that binding with InferenceX's own selector (`infx.srt_slurm.single_node.select_recipe`) at the pinned commit. Each point therefore renders the variant the sweep ran. - **Rules.** Removed as telemetry: - srt-slurm's job-local OTLP collector (`otelcol-contrib`); - the variables it injects (`DYN_LIFECYCLE_TRACE_ENABLED`, `OTEL_EXPORT_ENABLED`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`). - **GPU count and cluster environment** follow #44228. - H200 TP2·EP2 shows 2 GPUs and TP4·EP4 shows 4. - The H200 cluster does not export `NCCL_CUMEM_ENABLE`, so the H200 commands carry no cluster variable. Each lane is still rendered at the exact commit of the run that produced its dashboard data. - **Removed (SA-only settings):** the benchmark harness, cluster paths and caches, telemetry, and InferenceX's synthetic speculative acceptance (disclosed per deployment). - **Replaced with placeholders:** IPs, ports and NICs. - **Derived variants:** router and KV-offload variants that were not run are derived and labeled "Derived — not run". The data file is generated, so there is no hand-written change to review. ## Validation - **CI gates.** - `node docs/scripts/check_cookbook_configs.mjs` passes. - `mint broken-links --check-anchors --check-redirects` passes (mint 4.2.559, the CI pin). - **`mint validate` fails on `main` today**, for a reason outside this PR: - Since #44693, `docs/src/snippets/configs/popular-models.jsx` has a stray `},` at line 100, so that snippet does not parse. - With that one line removed locally (not part of this PR), `mint validate` passes on this branch. - **Browser click-through** of the Qwen3.8-Flash-Next page under `mint dev`: - All 94 combinations of hardware, checkpoint, deployment, concurrency, KV tier and router render exactly the decoded commands (0 mismatches, 0 unseen, no browser errors), with every tab clicked. - Each deployment's "Copy link" URL restores the same selection in a fresh tab (5 of 5). - The Deployment-panel footer link is present on this page and absent on two control pages. - Copy, Copy all and Copy link work. - **Decoder and KV flags.** - The component's own decoder reproduces the generated commands for all 94 router × KV combinations, including the 48 measured tiers. - Every KV-cache flag shown exists in its deployment's SGLang commit (11 image/flag pairs, 170 uses). - **Round trip and leak scan.** Every flag and variable of every submitted launch is kept, rewritten or removed by a rule. No SemiAnalysis cluster artifact appears in the shown commands. - **Diff against `main`.** - The 66 GB300, B300 and B200 command sets are unchanged. - H200's 10 command sets (5 points × 2 routers) are replaced by 28 (7 points × 2 routers × 2 KV tiers). - **Against the real run.** For all seven H200 points, the rendered `sglang.launch_server` flags equal those in the public job logs of [run 39109720946](https://github.com/SemiAnalysisAI/InferenceX/actions/runs/39109720946) (25 or 26 flags each). - The only difference is `--model-path`: a container mount versus the Hugging Face id. The page shows the id. - **pre-commit.** - The hooks that apply to the changed file pass with `pre-commit run --files`: trailing whitespace, end of file, large files, merge conflicts, private key and codespell. - `pre-commit run --all-files` in `lmsysorg/sglang:dev-cu13` was not run. - **Argument parsing** in the submission image was not run. - The H200 commands are the ones that started and served successfully with this exact image in run 39109720946 (previous bullet). No serving or benchmark runs were performed for this PR; the numbers live in the linked SemiAnalysis run. SGLang CI was not triggered. cc @nvpohanh
AI assistance Prepared with Claude Code (model `claude-opus-5-5`): the sync, the validation above and this description. Reviewed by @Ankur-singh before opening.
